turns.prompt_text: Tell me more about new Gemini features​ that just launched at Google I/O.
turns.response_html:
Hi! Let me catch you up on the latest updates from I/O.

I've picked up a few new ways to help run your day and take your ideas to the next level.

  • Gemini Omni: Creating, remixing, and editing videos is easier than ever. You can also create an avatar to add yourself to videos.
  • Gemini Spark: Think of me as a 24/7 personal AI agent. Coming soon for Google AI Ultra subscribers.
  • Daily brief: Get a personalized overview of what matters each day.
  • Gemini Live: Switch seamlessly between typing and talking.

Those are just some highlights, but there's more to discover. You can find these new features in your side navigation and in chat.

Enough about me! What can I help you with today?

turns.prompt_text: Tell me more about Gemini spark
turns.response_html:
What is Gemini Spark?

At its core, Gemini Spark is an always-on, 24/7 personal AI agent designed to handle the heavy lifting of daily coordination. Instead of just answering questions, it actively plans, coordinates, and executes multi-step tasks autonomously in the background—even when your phone or laptop is turned off.

Key Capabilities

  • Autonomous Workflows: You can hand off complex, multi-step projects from start to finish. For example, Spark can monitor your inbox for updates on a specific topic, compile those findings into a new Google Doc, and draft a status email to your team.
  • Deep App Integration: It connects seamlessly across the Google Workspace ecosystem (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Slides) using structured APIs, and is built to integrate with over 30 third-party tools.
  • Teachable Skills: You can teach Spark reusable behaviors using natural language. If you want it to help write outreach emails, it can analyze your past messages to learn your specific writing style and apply it to future drafts.
  • Recurring Triggers: You can set tasks to repeat on a schedule or fire when specific conditions are met. For instance, you could have Spark automatically pull your logged hours from a spreadsheet, generate an invoice, and prep it for sending on the first of every month.

How It Works Safely

  • Powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash: Spark runs on our highly efficient model optimized for speed, complex workflows, and long multi-turn interactions.
  • Enterprise-Grade Security: Every task executes in a fresh, strictly isolated, and ephemeral virtual machine on Google Cloud to ensure your data stays secure and never overlaps between sessions.
  • Human in the Loop: While Spark works autonomously, you stay in complete control. It requires explicit permission before executing any high-stakes actions, such as actually hitting "send" on an email or making a purchase.

Availability

Spark is currently rolling out to trusted testers and will be available in beta next week for Google AI Ultra subscribers in the United States. Future updates will also bring Spark to the Gemini desktop app, allowing it to interface directly with local files.
